# apple_analytics_report_instances (Data Source)

Lists the instances of an analytics report: one per granularity and processing date, each a set of files to download.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_analytics_report_instances" "daily" {
  report_id     = data.apple_analytics_reports.sessions.reports[0].id
  granularities = ["DAILY"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `report_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the report; see `data.apple_analytics_reports`.

### Optional

- `granularities` (Set of String) Granularities to list. Values: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`.
- `processing_dates` (Set of String) Processing dates to list, e.g. `2026-11-16`.

### Read-Only

- `instances` (Attributes List) The instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances))

<a id="nestedatt--instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances`

Read-Only:

- `granularity` (String) Granularity of the data: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the instance.
- `processing_date` (String) Day the data became available.
